title: What Happens to a Dataset Transformed by a Projection-based Concept Removal Method?

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates the effectiveness of removing sentiment information (treated as the concept/bias to be removed) from text representations (BoW and BERT) using projection-based methods (INLP). It measures the residual presence of sentiment by calculating cross-validation accuracy of classifiers, analyzing the distribution of predicted probabilities, examining nearest-neighbor structures, and applying anti-clustering algorithms to recover the original sentiment labels.
